calculation: composition-dependent pp evolution with instantaneous convective mixing
nuclear_physics: Solar Fusion II quadrature; finite-degeneracy Salpeter--Van Horn screening
opacity: AESOPUS/TOPS X/Z family, number-density isotope mapping; GS98 metal proxy
nuclear_limitations: reduced pp network: no pep, hep, ppIII or CNO; SFII pp curvature omitted; SVH approximate, not derived from FreeEOS; modern screening requires zeta<=.2
mass_basis: conserved baryonic mass; nuclear rest mass release accounted in energy, Newtonian gravity
age_origin: specified static composition, not age since formation
eos: FreeEOS potential family; He3 number-density mapping; metals as He4
limitations: source domains enforced; He isotope cross sections approximated, GS98 metals; COND differential grey correction is approximate; Schwarzschild criterion, no Ledoux/diffusion/remeshing; conduction mixture and envelope join approximations
reference_run_provenance_note: Long references began with the Z=.01/.02 TOPS source pair; the later Z=.03 plane does not enter their mapped-Z interpolation. Subsequent driver changes add atmosphere settings and a measured initial convective fraction to JSON. The original initial-fraction placeholder is omitted from this compact history.
